title: RepliClaw benchmark run record
description: One completed (or aborted) benchmark run for one (case, arm, seed) triple. Token usage follows the fail-loud convention: usage_present=false means the provider reported no usage and the numeric fields must be null — never zero-filled (P08 Q13).

run_id.description: Conventional shape {case}::{arm}::seed{n}, matching repliclaw.counterfactual run ids.

token_usage.description: Actual per-arm token usage across all LLM calls in the run.

cached.description: Cached/prompt-cache-read tokens if the provider reports them; null when unknown.

usage_present.description: false => all numeric fields are null; the run is not accounted as 0 tokens.

token_usage.description: This schema is a SUBSET of the RunRecord dataclass invariants (J-CODE Wave 0, F5): with usage_present=true, the dataclass additionally enforces that whatever numerics are present are non-negative integers and that no present value is zero-filled padding. Schema-only raw-JSON consumers (ingest, cross-language scoring) MUST also load the dataclass or apply that check; the schema rejects the unambiguous cases (bool/str numerics via `type`, and false=>all-null above).

tool_call_counts.description: Map of tool name -> call count. Empty object when no tool calls occurred.

intervention_counts.description: Counts of interventions applied in this run.

abort_reason.description: Required non-null iff status starts with 'aborted_' or status is 'invalid_usage'; null for completed runs.

provenance_sha256.description: SHA-256 of the run's provenance.json when captured.
